                break;

                int count = 0;

                    count++;
                    current = (1LL * k * current) % p;
                } while (current != start);
                
                if (count > 0) {
                    result = (result * p) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << result << '\n';
    return 0;
}

using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
constexpr int MAXN = 1000010;
const ll MOD = 1000000007;

int main() {
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    vector<bool> visited(p + 1, false);
    ll result = 1;
    
    if (k == 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < p - 1; ++i)
            result = result * p % MOD;
    } else {
        // Compute modular inverse of k mod p
        int inv_k = -1;
        for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
            if (1LL * i * k % p == 1) {
                inv_k = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        for (int node = 1; node < p; ++node) {
            if (!visited[node]) {
                vector<int> cycle;
                int cur = node;
                
                while (!visited[cur]) {
                    visited[cur] = true;
                    cycle.push_back(cur);
                    cur = 1LL * k * cur % p;
                }
                
                // Compute k^(cycle.size()) mod p
                ll power = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)cycle.size(); ++i)
                    power = (power * k) % p;
                
                if (power == 1)
                    result = result * p % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << result << '\n';
    return 0;
}
